limitations: F:ml430-nat-modeq-comm-24b71e7a is listed because its export exists, NOT because it is selectable: the ledger makes it depend on the symmetry fact, so it is not dependency-ready and frontier_select never returns it. Listing an export is not selecting a fact.
trust_boundary: This file resolves a fact id to the frozen, proof-free statement export a tier-C agent tool may import. It confers no dispatch, proof, admission or registration authority; the tool re-hashes every export before importing it and refuses on a mismatch, so an entry here cannot make the loop read bytes nobody pinned.
why_this_file_exists: Every other frozen export in this repository is reachable because a committed statement-adapter manifest carries `source_fact_id` and `external_artifact`; the tier-C tools resolve through those manifests first and this index is never consulted for them. The four Nat.ModEq development exports have no such manifest: they were produced for the blind development-set generalization probe recorded in docs/autogenesis/242-nat-division-gates-modular-arithmetic.md and never registered, because docs/autogenesis/250-natural-modeq-capability-selection.md deliberately stops at selection. Deriving their paths from a naming convention would be a resolution nobody can audit, so they are named here with the digest that pins them.
